content.introduction: The U.S. stock markets on September 30, 2026, showed mixed performance with the Nasdaq and S&P 500 managing gains while the Dow Jones retreated. Technology stocks led the upward momentum. On the same day, notable stocks like Carnival Corporation, Bloom Energy Corp., and Royal Caribbean Group saw significant gains. Major indices like the Dow Jones, S&P 500, and Nasdaq 100 also closed higher, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 seeing increases of 0.51% and 0.42% respectively. Specific stocks such as Applied Materials Inc., Doordash Inc., and Marvell Technology Inc. also experienced notable gains.
body: US markets retreated on September 29, 2026, with all major indices ending the session in negative territory. A broader Treasury selloff weighed on investor sentiment, extending pressure on equities as traders prepared for a week defined by critical employment data. [...] US markets finished the session on a mixed note on September 30, 2026, as the Nasdaq and S&P 500 managed gains while the Dow Jones retreated. Technology stocks led the upward momentum, helping major indices navigate a day of varied performance across different sectors. [...] US stocks closed lower on September 28, 2026, as a broad-based selloff pressured the major indices. Heightened investor caution reflected in rising volatility and climbing Treasury yields weighed on market sentiment throughout the session.
